call_points.text: Historically and on current OEM indications, H2 volumes are expected to be 20% higher than H1.
Extruded axle beam commercial output commenced, currently accounting for 80% of trailer axle output.
Company is investing ₹20-25 Cr in forward integration into cold drawn tubes for captive and merchant precision applications.
Receivable days dropped from over 110 days in H1 last year to around 90 days in H1FY27.
Steel and consumable cost increases are recurring quarterly, with price settlements lagging but compensated retrospectively.
M&HCV demand momentum continued, with Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2.
Exports contribute approximately 8% of total component business, with a commitment to increase the share.
Commercial vehicle demand remains robust with key OEMs reporting strong volume growth in Q4 continuing into April 2026.
Management targets increasing the tractor segment contribution to approximately 15% of total revenue over the next two years.
EBITDA margin is expected to remain between 14% to 15% for future quarters.
